subject: general
question: Which of the following communities was NOT included for fast-track citizenship under Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) of 2019?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Muslims**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) of 2019** was introduced to provide fast-track citizenship to individuals belonging to **specific religious communities** who faced persecution in Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Bangladesh.
 
• The act specifically included **Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi, and Christian communities** but excluded Muslim
